login.title: Sign in — Trading bot
login.heading: Sign in
language.name: English
auth.lockout: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
auth.view_only: This account can look, not change.
positions.title: Open positions
positions.help: Profit is net: the sale commission and the tax on the gain are taken off the proceeds, then compared with the cost of the buy (price plus commissions and taxes already recorded). Current threshold: {threshold}.
positions.help_trail: At the threshold the lot is armed: it stays open while its score is at least {delay} and the close is less than {trail} under the peak since then, and it is sold when either fails or the net profit falls back to the threshold. After {days} days a lot is sold at any result.
positions.help_now: With At once on, the lot is sold as soon as the net profit is at the threshold, even if the price is old. Under the threshold nothing is sold.
positions.now_title: Latest stored price. Below, its date.
positions.profit_title: Net profit if sold at the latest price, after the sale commission and the tax on the gain, against the cost of the buy. Below, the result against the threshold.
sell.missing: That open lot was not found.
buy.title: Record a buy
buy.help: This is the opening record of the lot. Leave price and commissions empty and the bot uses the latest price in the archive and the commission rate from preferences; the rate is stored with the buy. Taxes on the buy stay zero unless you set them: tax on the gain is calculated on the sale.
buy.bad_numbers: Quantity, price, or costs are not readable.
buy.bad_amount: Quantity must be greater than zero.
buy.over_billion: Quantity and price stay within one billion.
buy.over_max: The amount is above the maximum investment. Raise the preference or reduce the quantity.
buy.over_balance: The buy exceeds available Balance. Raise initial capital or reduce the quantity.
buy.negative: Commissions and taxes cannot be negative.
topbuy.title: Next bot buys
topbuy.score_title: Buy score from the last cycle (−1 to +1)
topbuy.qty_title: Quantity of one lot at that close: the investment divided by the price, fractional or whole shares as set in the preferences
topbuy.pending: The list appears after the next cycle.
topbuy.empty: No name has a buy score now.
topbuy.help: Next bot buys lists, by score, the names with a buy score from the last cycle that you do not own. Each cycle, after the sales, the bot buys at most one lot: the first on the list, if the cash covers the lot and its estimated commission and the daily cap is not reached.
decisions.title: Latest bot decisions
decisions.no_cash: no buy: not enough cash for {symbol}, lot {cost}, cash {cash}
tx.title: Transactions
tx.help: Each sale is paired with the FIFO buy lot it closed. Margin is net of commissions and tax against carrying cost. Each row keeps its own rates. On open lots the values marked ≈ are estimates at the latest price and current rates; they are not in the paid totals nor in Total Balance.
tx.show_closed_sum: Show or hide the closed totals
tx.buy_side_title: Unit buy price and carrying cost of the closed slice.
tx.sell_side_title: Unit sell price and net proceeds of the slice (after sale commissions and tax).
tx.net_title: Net percentage. Green is a gain, red a loss.
tx.cost_title: Carrying cost of the quantity still open: notional (quantity × price) plus proportional commissions and taxes.
tx.fees_title: Buy plus sale commission of this slice. Below, each one with the rate it was charged at: buy on the Bought line, sale on the Sold line.
tx.fee_sell_est_title: Estimated sell commission if the lot were sold now, at the current rate.
tx.taxes_title: Tax charged on the sale of this slice. Below, the rate and the gain it was charged on.
tx.taxes_open_title: Estimated tax if the lot were sold now: the current tax rate on the gain at the latest stored price, after both commissions. Not charged, not in Balance.
tx.cash_title: Closed slice: net result after commissions and tax. It is already in Total Balance.
tx.cash_open_title: Net result if the lot were sold now at the latest stored price, after the sale commission and the estimated tax. Total Balance still counts the lot at its cost.
volume.heading: Volume and state
volume.scope.all_title: All sectors, each name inside its group
volume.scope.sector_title: Sector and group choose which names are drawn
volume.caption_all: All sectors, as blocks. In the chart: {shown}. Size is volume.
volume.caption: Among {where}, the {count} names with the highest return over the last {sessions} sessions. In the chart: {shown}. Size is volume.
tile.color.explanation: The color and the percentage on the tile are the change of the latest stored session against the session immediately before it.
volume.bad_count: Names must be from 10 to 500, in steps of 10.
chart.line_no_ohlc: {asset} — daily closes (open, high and low are missing)
volume.none: No name with volume. Update prices.
quotes.fetch_recent: Downloading recent sessions, batch {index} of {total} ({count} names).
quotes.fetch_full: Downloading six-month history, batch {index} of {total} ({count} names).
quotes.retry: Yahoo closed the call with no bars. Waiting 45 seconds and trying once more.
quotes.skip: Batch {index} skipped. Continuing with the others.
quotes.partial: This run did not update {failed} names. New bars: {stored}. History already stored stays. The next run retries only the ones left behind.
prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.foot: Commission and tax start at 0.1% and 26% of the gain. Lot: Fractional spends the investment ({investment} $) on each lot; Whole shares rounds it down to whole shares and skips names priced above it. Buys/day: 0 = no limit. Massive plan: Automatic reads it from the key.
prefs.sell_at_title: Sells as soon as the net profit reaches the threshold. The price age does not count, and nothing under the threshold is sold. Off, age, peak, score and trail apply.
prefs.capital_title: Starting paper budget. Later this can come from the broker and become read-only.
prefs.balance_title: Paper cash left: initial capital minus buys (with commissions and taxes) plus sells (net of commissions and taxes).
prefs.fee_title: Commission (0.001 = 0.1%). Applies to new transactions; stored rows keep their own rate.
prefs.tax_title: Tax on the gain (0.26 = 26%). Applies to new sales; stored rows keep their own rate.
prefs.side_title: Shorter side of a block, in the 16×9 frame. Below this the block is left out. A lower value keeps more blocks.
prefs.divide_title: On keeps the shorter ratio when two contiguous blocks have two arrangements. Off keeps the first arrangement.
prefs.volume_scale_title: On uses the 1.618 ratio and the shifted colors. Off draws Volume All as it was before that ratio.
prefs.names_title: How many names to show (10 to 500, in steps of 10)
prefs.days_title: Days of history in the chart
prefs.sessions_title: Sessions used to measure the return, from 1 to 240
prefs.age_title: Maximum price age for a sale (hours)
prefs.hold_title: Days after which a lot is sold at the latest close, at any result
prefs.sizing_title: Quantity of a lot: fractional (investment / price) or whole shares (names priced above the lot are skipped)
prefs.buys_day_title: Bot buys per day; 0 = no limit
prefs.plan_title: Data plan of the Massive key. Automatic detects it once a day; a named plan overrides the detection. Basic: end of day only, 5 calls a minute. Starter and Developer: prices 15 minutes late during the session. Advanced: real time.
prefs.plan_refused: intraday refused today, end of day
history.title: Daily bars the {plan} plan reaches: from {start}. The fill runs in the background, one session at a time, and resumes where it stopped.
history.busy: A history fill is already running.
prefs.trail_title: Drop from the peak since arming that sells a lot above the threshold (0.03 = 3%)
prefs.delay_title: A lot above the threshold stays open while its score is at or above this value
prefs.scale_title: Size and line height (%). The percentage applies to both.
prefs.theme_title: Light and Dark stay fixed. Automatic follows local time: light from 7 to 19, dark from 19 to 7.
prefs.draw_title: History drawing. Vector (SVG) is the default. Image (PNG) is the fallback for older machines.
prefs.err.numbers: One of the numbers is not readable.
prefs.err.scale_read: The type size is not readable.
prefs.err.profit: The profit threshold must be between 0 and 5.
prefs.err.invest: The maximum investment must be greater than zero.
prefs.err.capital: Initial capital must be greater than zero.
prefs.err.fee: The commission must be between 0 and 0.1.
prefs.err.tax: The tax must be between 0 and 0.5.
prefs.err.band: The flat band must be between 0 and 0.2.
prefs.err.side: The shorter side must be between 0 and 2.
prefs.err.names: Names in the volume chart run from 10 to 500, in steps of 10.
prefs.err.chart: The history chart can be a line or candles.
prefs.err.draw: The history drawing can be an image or a vector.
prefs.err.scale: Size and line height run from 80 to 120, in steps of 5.
prefs.err.theme: The theme can be light, dark, or automatic.
prefs.err.symbol: The chart symbol is not valid.
prefs.err.limits: History days, sessions, or price age are out of range.
prefs.err.notice: The message seconds must be between 3 and 30.
prefs.err.hold: The maximum days must be between 1 and 3650.
prefs.err.trail: The trail must be between 0 and 0.5.
prefs.err.delay: The keep score must be between −1 and 1.
prices.current: Prices are already up to date.
prices.queue: Massive: {pending} closed sessions still to fill. This run requests {chosen}. The open session is not included.
prices.plan: Session {day} is outside the plan history. It will not be requested again.
prices.empty: Session {day} has no bars. It will not be requested again.
prices.partial: Session {day} returned only {count} names from the list. Stopping before marking it complete.
prices.auth: Massive rejected the key. Bars already written stay.
prices.rate: Massive asked to slow down. Bars already written stay.
prices.incomplete: Massive did not finish the download. Bars already written stay.
prices.done: Update finished. Bars written: {stored}. Sales recorded: {sold}.
prices.dead: The last update is no longer running. Start it again.
reread.running: Reading sessions already in the archive.
reread.ready: The extra fields are already on every archived session.
reread.queue: Reading {count} sessions already in the archive. The response has no fields beyond the ones now stored.
error.internal: Internal error. The detail is in the bot log.

tx.fees_open_title: ≈ Buy commission paid plus the sale commission the lot would pay if sold now. Below, each one with its rate: buy on the Bought line, sale on the Sale fee line.
tx.tax_title: Rate of the tax and the gain it was charged on: sale value minus the sale commission, minus the buy value and the buy commission.
tx.total_fees_title: Commissions written on every row: buy and sale of the closed slices plus the buy of the open lots.
tx.total_taxes_title: Taxes written on every row. Open lots have paid none yet.
tx.total_balance_title: Cash: initial capital minus the cost of every buy plus the net proceeds of every sale.
tx.est_fees_title: ≈ Sale commissions the open lots would add if sold now at the latest price. Not paid, not in the totals above.
tx.est_taxes_title: ≈ Tax the open lots would add if sold now at the latest price and the current rate. Not paid, not in the totals above.
